# FFNDS Copilot research instructions

**Default to AutoResearcher** for every research-oriented repository task. Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the compact [research state](../research/ACTIVE_RESEARCH.json). Select one mechanism/source/reformulation skill automatically according to the unresolved scientific decision; proceed with mechanism → source math → discriminating prediction → constructive next action.

The current three questions are **upstream information existence**, **incremental NetVOI after actual observation/dispatch cost**, and **which native FFN work can be omitted while preserving whole-video quality**. No algorithm family, dense-row restoration or R256 is selected by default. Distinguish local deterministic hidden prediction from downstream residual-bypass action value. Check the nearest actual code and prior science, and preserve precisely scoped old results. Present discoveries and decisions first, not defensive preambles or long approval checklists.

Dated handoffs/old PRD/TACR/C2/dense/SVD tasks are history even when they say "active". `research/ACTIVE_RESEARCH.json` is the only live research task selector. FFNDS CPU/GPU/model experiments and automatic retries **remain paused** per `research/20261024/EXPERIMENT_PAUSE.json`. No old authority resumes them.
